newsitem.title: CANADA: OLCO sets supply deal with Neste.
newsitem.headline: OLCO sets supply deal with Neste.

text.p: OLCO Petroleum Group Inc said on Thursday that it had entered into an exclusive five-year supply agreement with Neste Petroleum (Canada) Inc, an integrated petroleum refiner and subsidiary of Neste Oy of Finland.
The agreement provides for increased volumes and better utilization of OLCO's terminal assets, through Neste's worldwide access to petroleum supplies, said Mark Kaneb, OLCO's president.
"For OLCO it will further guarantee supply to our customers at competitive prices and will provide us with the opportunity to market new environmentally-friendly products," Kaneb said.
